meta.description: Medicinal chemistry filters for compound triage using drug-likeness rules (Lipinski, Veber, CNS, lead-like), structural alert catalogs (PAINS, NIBR, ChEMBL, Brenk), complexity metrics, functional group detection, and the medchem query language. Targets medchem 2.0.5 with complete API coverage for high-throughput library filtering and prioritization.

scientific_integrity.detail: Clear statements that filters are context-specific guidelines requiring domain expertise; warns against universal thresholds

practice_boundaries.detail: Explicitly states rules are guidelines not absolute requirements; documents that marketed drugs violate Ro5; emphasizes combining with target knowledge

methodological_ground.detail: Based on established medchem library (datamol-io) with literature-derived rules and named catalogs from ChEMBL, NIBR, validated sources

code_usability.detail: Production-ready patterns with functional API, batch processing, parallelization, and bundled filtering script

functional_suitability.note: Complete medchem filtering coverage: rules, alerts, complexity, groups, query language, with functional and class-based APIs

reliability.note: Excellent API documentation with return type clarity (DataFrames vs boolean arrays), parallel processing guidance, and Lilly demerits optional handling

performance_context.note: Strong performance guidance with n_jobs=-1 parallelization recommendation for >1000 molecules; SKILL.md 322 lines well-structured

agent_usability.note: Clear API organization (rules, structural, catalogs, functional) with examples; minor: query language syntax could have more complex examples

human_usability.note: Natural triggers (drug-likeness, PAINS, medicinal chemistry, compound triage), clear when-to-use section, workflow patterns

security.note: Local-only processing, no credential handling, SMILES/SMARTS pattern matching is safe, optional conda dependency clearly marked

maintainability.note: Well-organized with 2 reference files (API guide, rules catalog), version pinning (2.0.5), bundled CLI script, clear module structure

agent_specific.note: Good composability with datamol/RDKit ecosystem; deterministic for same inputs; minor: could strengthen multi-stage pipeline orchestration guidance

key_strengths: Excellent scientific grounding with clear statements that rules are context-specific guidelines, not absolute requirements
Comprehensive API with dual patterns (class-based for detailed output, functional for boolean masks) clearly distinguished
Strong query language feature combining rules, alerts, properties, groups, and substructures with boolean logic
Outstanding best practices section emphasizing context, combination of filters, parallelization, return types, and documentation
Production-ready with bundled CLI, version pinning (2.0.5), performance guidance, and optional dependency handling

recommendations.title: Clarify inverted semantic of chemical_group_filter
recommendations.problem: Functional API chemical_group_filter returns molecules that do NOT match the group, which is inverted from expected filter behavior
recommendations.root_cause: API design choice not prominently documented in usage examples
recommendations.fix: Add inline comment in examples: '# Note: returns molecules WITHOUT the group (use for exclusion filtering)' or rename to exclude_chemical_group

recommendations.title: Add more complex query language examples
recommendations.problem: Query language examples show simple 2-clause queries; complex nested logic not demonstrated
recommendations.root_cause: Documentation prioritizes basic usage over advanced patterns
recommendations.fix: Add example with nested logic: 'MATCHRULE("rule_of_five") AND (HASPROP("mw", <, 400) OR HASGROUP("privileged")) AND NOT HASALERT("pains")'
